topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: Master, I know little of the great halls and the dealings of those above, but I've heard the whispers that Barley, he who tended the books with such careful hand, has been moved to serve under the steward in the east wing. I do not know what this means, but it seems the winds turn cold and fast. The soil, it can change in a day, from rich to barren if the rains refuse to come. I pray to Saint Columba that this change brings fruit, for the reaping will come, and we must have Barley's accounts straight to meet our dues. The lord does not look kindly on short measures, and without the right numbers, the earth might as well be parched. God keep us all.
